svg.title: For centered sums all weights through w cancel and every remaining d ≥w + 1 obeys c −ds ≤ c −(w + 1)(s −u) −du. For general e, approximate at precision min(q, q −maxFee(w) −wu), with maxFee(w) = Pw j=0 probeFee(j). Projection of the error costs at most maxFee(w) + wu, so both errors fit precision q. Subtract them and apply the finite sum result. At u = s simply subtract the projected affordable expression with zero gain. Repeated UC3 supplies each signed ancestor move’s full w +1 gain in the contact forest. Funds multiply across separated layer-s palettes, s ≤1, by adding costs. For e, f with funds (s, c), (s, d) and finite terminal costs a, b, first approximate e by g at precision q −b. Then enlarge g to terminal layer one and record its actual finite cost c′.
